newsitem.title: USA: Sri Lanka buys 100,000 T Argentine/EU wheat-trade.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka buys 100,000 T Argentine/EU wheat-trade.

text.p: Sri Lanka on Wednesday night bought a total of 100,000 tonnes of wheat, 50,000 tonnes of which was Argentine hard wheat and 50,000 tonnes of European Union soft wheat, several U.S. exporters said.
One U.S. exporter said the wheat was slated for April delivery but another exporter said the shipment for the European wheat was set for March 31-April 9 and the Argentine hard wheat for April 21-30.
The second exporter said the European wheat was bought at around $179.20 per tonne cost and freight and the Argentine wheat was purchased at $192.06 C and F.
